code: library(glyospalettes)  # which companies are covered, and how many palettes each has glyos_companies() table(glyos_colorways$company)  # palette names, optionally for one company or product line glyos_palette_names() glyos_palette_names(company = "TheGodBeast") glyos_palette_names(line = "Battle Tribes")  # the colors of one colorway (prints the swatches and the hex codes) glyos_palette("spectre") #> Glyos colorway 'spectre' (4 colors) #> Onell Design / Glyos: Spectre #> #EEFADA #BCC99B #9EB49A #5FC3A8  # first three colors, a 12-step gradient, or the same gradient dark-to-light glyos_palette("glyaxia", 3) glyos_palette("hades", 12, type = "continuous") glyos_palette("hades", 12, type = "continuous", sort = TRUE)  # swatches with hex codes, for one company at a time glyos_show_palettes(company = "Onell Design") glyos_show_palettes(company = "Spy Monkey Creations", ncol = 2)  # one color per colorway, or the most separable few colors from a pool glyos_combine(line = "Kabuto Mushi") glyos_pick(c("glyaxia", "hades"), n = 5)

title: glyospalettes - Glyos colorway palettes for R
text: Whole palettes faithful figures, chart. glyos_pick() pools colors palettes name (whole company line), drops read background (white "light" "grayscale", near-black "dark", judged WCAG contrast), chooses n colors whose closest pair farthest apart CIE Lab. colorblind = TRUE distance worst case across simulated deuteranopia, protanopia tritanopia; style = "grayscale" lightness counts, result survives black--white printer. color named palette came , min_distance attribute reports separable closest pair (20 comfortable, 12 risky). contrast filter strict purpose: pale glow---dark clear colors fail white, light-mode pick Spectre alone nothing work . Lower min_contrast keep , pass different background.
code: # five colors for a white-background plot, from two classic colorways glyos_pick(c("glyaxia", "hades"), n = 5)  # four color-blind-safe colors for a dark theme, from a whole line glyos_pick(line = "Kabuto Mushi", n = 4, style = "dark", colorblind = TRUE)  # printable in grayscale, from everything Toyfinity made glyos_pick(company = "Toyfinity", n = 4, style = "grayscale")  ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, color = drv)) +   geom_point(size = 2.5) +   scale_color_manual(values = unname(glyos_pick(c("glyaxia", "hades"), 3)))

title: glyospalettes 0.3.0
text: Fifteen new palettes releases since first sampling pass: Paleolords Wave 1 figures (Dan Suarez’s new Glyos-compatible line, listed company “Swamp City Collectibles” paleo_ prefix), plus new Battle Tribes, Mighty Maniax, Warlords Wor, /V Robot Cappy Space figures. 208 palettes total. New glyos_credit() writes figure-caption acknowledgments sentence naming colorways used companies designed , follows picks combines back source palettes. citation("glyospalettes") now returns reference package . New glyos_pick() pools colors one palettes (whole company product line), drops poor WCAG contrast light, dark grayscale background, returns n colors whose closest pair farthest apart CIE Lab, optionally judged simulated color-vision deficiency. New glyos_combine() takes one color set palettes, product line becomes categorical palette one color per figure; distinct = TRUE spreads choices legibility. return named vectors (color source palette) print provenance; picks draw swatches background chosen . mirror tf_pick() tf_team_palette() sibling transformerpalettes package.
